title: 客户举债买芯片：英伟达风险信号，未来收入要变？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The world's most valuable company in video, smashing it out of the park once again with its earnings, forecasting revenue growth in fiscal 2028 of 70% beating on almost every single metric.
segments.zh: 全球最有价值的公司再次交出亮眼财报，预计2028财年营收增长70%，几乎各项指标都超预期。

segments.en: So what's not to like? Well, some investors are pointing to this. This white line is the spike in credit default swap prices for Nvidia. That essentially is the cost to ensure against default
